Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — excited about the traction we're starting to see in Cohort E9. We're about to flip the integration live for three accelerator teams but the timing hit a snag: two weeks of delayed onboarding pushed our expected usage spike into next month.

Could Redwood approve a short bridge of pilot credits (one-off promotional credit) to cover the uplift while we finish onboarding? We're requesting $3,000 worth of credits (~20k tokens equivalent under standard trial rates).

I've attached our proposed milestone schedule and a small usage extract so you can see the expected curve. If helpful, we can accept a conditional approval tied to the milestones — whatever reduces friction on your end.

Attachments: [cohort_e9_milestones.pdf (PDF), glintai_usage_nov.csv (CSV)]

Appreciate any flexibility here — goal is to ensure the cohort experience stays smooth and we can convert to a paid seat after the initial month.

Hi Leo — thanks for the details and the attachments. I reviewed the milestone PDF and the usage extract. Quick answers: we can do a conditional, time-limited pilot credit, but I need signoff from Sales (Ben) and CS (Monica) on the terms.

Ben/Monica — looping you both in. Proposed path:
- Approve up to $3k in promotional credit applied to the account as a one-time pilot grant.
- Credit is conditional on hitting onboarding milestone M2 (3 active users, basic integration events) within 14 days of credit issuance.
- If the recipient misses the milestone, credit is voided and no refund/chargeback applies.
- Require a simple one-page MPA acknowledging the credit terms (DocuSign OK).

Leo — if that structure works for you, we'll draft the MPA and Ben will confirm the credit issuance timeline.

Thanks,

Vanessa/Leo — happy to approve a conditional pilot credit. Summary of agreed terms below (I'll also drop a short DocuSign MPA for signature):

- Credit amount: $3,000 one-time promotional credit (applied as account credit, non-transferable).
- Conditions: Cohort E9 must hit onboarding milestone M2 (>=3 active team users AND 100 integration events) within 14 days of credit issuance.
- Expiry: If milestone not met within 14 days, remaining credit is revoked.
- Activation: Credit will go live within 48 hours of signed MPA receipt.
- Reporting: GlintAI to send a usage snapshot at day 7 and day 14 to cs@redwood.com.

3) Vanessa — happy to own issuance after signature.
